instructions: Check the answer that best describes how you have felt and conducted yourself over the past 6 months. Questions 1-6 are the official ASRS v1.1 screener (intended for people aged 18 or older). Questions 7-20 are extra MindCheck questions about everyday patterns; they give you a separate profile and do not change the screener score.

traits.name: Attention & organisation
traits.description: Finishing, organising, remembering and starting tasks.

traits.name: Restlessness & activity
traits.description: Fidgeting and feeling driven to keep moving.

traits.name: Focus
traits.description: Staying with one thing when attention drifts or distractions appear.

traits.name: Organisation
traits.description: Keeping track of belongings, spaces and routine steps.

traits.name: Time management
traits.description: Estimating time, being on time and avoiding last-minute rushes.

traits.name: Impulsivity
traits.description: Acting or speaking before pausing to think.

traits.name: Everyday restlessness
traits.description: Needing to move or finding quiet time hard.

questions.text: How often do you have trouble wrapping up the final details of a project, once the challenging parts have been done?
How often do you have difficulty getting things in order when you have to do a task that requires organization?
How often do you have problems remembering appointments or obligations?
When you have a task that requires a lot of thought, how often do you avoid or delay getting started?
How often do you fidget or squirm with your hands or feet when you have to sit down for a long time?
How often do you feel overly active and compelled to do things, like you were driven by a motor?
How often does your mind wander during conversations or reading, even when you want to pay attention?
How often do you get distracted by things around you, such as sounds or notifications?
How often do you start several tasks without finishing them?
How often do you misplace everyday items like keys, your phone or documents?
How often does your room or workspace become cluttered faster than you can keep up with?
How often do you forget steps in routine tasks?
How often do you underestimate how long something will take?
How often are you late, even when you planned to be on time?
How often do you leave important tasks until the last minute?
How often do you interrupt others or finish their sentences?
How often do you make decisions or purchases on impulse that you later regret?
How often do you find it hard to wait your turn, for example in queues or conversations?
How often do you feel restless or find it hard to relax during quiet time?
How often do you need to keep moving, such as tapping, pacing or shifting position?

sources: Adult ADHD Self-Report Scale (ASRS v1.1) Screener. Kessler, R. C., et al. (2005). Psychological Medicine, 35(2), 245-256.
